title: Browserbase MCP Server
summary: Run browser sessions in the Browserbase cloud from your agent to open pages, act on them in plain language and extract data, via the self-hosted server.
description: Browserbase hosts headless browsers, and this server connects an agent to them through Stagehand. The tools are start, end, navigate, act, observe and extract, so the agent can describe a click in words and read structured data back.

This setup uses the self-hosted stdio package, @browserbasehq/mcp. It needs a Browserbase API key and project ID, plus a Gemini key for the default Stagehand model. You can pass --modelName and --modelApiKey to use another supported model.
Note that the repository is now archived and no longer maintained, and Browserbase points to a hosted endpoint instead. Check their docs if you want that route.
useWhen: Scrape a page that needs a real browser
Walk through a sign-up flow in a cloud session
Extract a table from a site into structured text
Run web automation without installing Chrome locally

mcp.name: browserbase

env.name: BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID
env.description: The Browserbase project the sessions run in

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Key for the default Stagehand model, google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite

access: Starts remote browser sessions on your Browserbase account and visits URLs the agent picks
Sends page content to the configured language model

example.prompt: Open https://example.com/pricing and extract the plan names with their monthly prices.
example.result: Started a session, navigated to the pricing page and extracted three plans: Free at 0, Team at 20 per seat, Business at 45 per seat. Session ended.

faq.question: Why do I need a Gemini key?
faq.answer: Stagehand uses a model to interpret act, observe and extract. The default is a Gemini model; pass --modelName and --modelApiKey to choose another one it supports.

faq.question: Will sessions bill my account?
faq.answer: Sessions run on Browserbase infrastructure under your project, so usage follows your Browserbase plan. Call the end tool when you finish.
